title: Candidate programme record
description: One fully-evidenced programme. Written by country/follow-up/cross-cut agents through checkpoint.py add-candidate. Fields prefixed '_' are added by merge.py and may not be written by agents.

^_.description: Computed by merge.py (e.g. _total, _rank, _overrides_applied). Not written by agents.

id.description: <PREFIX><yy>-<nn>, e.g. IT26-03. PREFIX = 2-4 capitals (ISO country code, or a cross-cut code). An optional trailing capital letter is allowed for follow-up revisions.

prior_id.description: Id in the prior ledger / baseline when this re-verifies a known entry; null for net-new.

status.description: net_new = not in the prior ledger; update_of_existing = re-assessed prior entry with changes; reconfirmed = re-assessed, unchanged.

replaces.description: Follow-up only: id of the first-pass record this one supersedes. merge.py keeps the replaced id and stores the old vector.

institution.description: Institution name (include faculty/department if it matters).

country.description: Country name (optional; merge adds a slug).

degree_type_and_length.description: e.g. 'MSc, 120 credits / 2 years; thesis-based' or 'MBA, 12 months full-time'. State the credit system used by the institution.

sources.description: One entry per evidence claim. Replaces the old fixed source_urls object. source_type and accessed_date are strongly recommended and are REQUIRED when a record is written through checkpoint.py (older/converted data may omit them; validate.py warns).

claim_field.description: What the source supports. Conventional values: programme, study_plan, pathway, admissions_language, tuition, scholarship, deadline. Free-form others allowed.

url.description: The page opened. Must be a page the agent actually opened, or null (then add a note and an open_question). Never invent a URL.

source_type.description: official = institution/government/funder page; aggregator = scholarship or ranking portal; pdf = document download; news; other.

accessed_date.description: Date the agent opened the page (YYYY-MM-DD).

note.description: What the page shows / why url is null.

axis_1_curriculum.description: Coverage by user-defined knowledge domain. Keys are the domain ids in study_pathway_map.domains (pattern ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$) - NOT a fixed A-J list.

^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$.description: Coverage of one knowledge domain by one programme.

grade.description: Evidence-based grade from NAMED modules in an official study plan. 'Unavailable' = study plan could not be located; never guess from a description page.

evidence.description: Module names/codes or the reason the grade is a judgement.

module_ids.description: Module codes or titles that justify the grade.

axis_2_pathway.description: Pathway evidence: the people and organisations connected to this programme that lead towards the person's goal (supervisors and labs, industry partners, internship or placement schemes, professional bodies).

people_and_partners.description: People and organisations relevant to the pathway signals. 'Exists at the institution' is not 'available to this programme's students': record that in takes_students.

name.description: Name of the group, lab, company, scheme or body.

type.description: What kind of entry this is.

url.description: Page the agent actually opened, or null (then add a note and an open_question). Never invent a URL.

contacts.description: Named people at this group or organisation.

role.description: Role or title, e.g. professor, programme director, placement lead, hiring manager.

focus.description: Focus relevant to the pathway signals.

recent_work.description: Recent publications, projects or placements, or 'not extracted'.

url.description: Staff, group or company page the agent actually opened, or null (then add a note and an open_question). Never invent a URL.

takes_students.description: confirmed = a page or the person says students of THIS programme can work with them (supervision, placement, internship, sponsored project); inferred = plausible from programme design; verification_needed = the entity exists but access for this programme's students is unknown.

evidence.description: Short note supporting the takes_students claim.

summary.description: What the pathway evidence adds up to.

practical_component.description: The practical element of the programme (thesis, internship, placement, capstone, co-op, studio or clinic).

credits.description: Credits it carries, in the institution's own credit system (null = not found).

self_proposed.description: May the student propose the topic or project? null = unknown.

external_host_allowed.description: May the practical component be done at an external host (company, other institution)? null = unknown.

progression.description: How the programme connects to what comes next: doctorate (formal pipeline or only informal?), graduate scheme, licensing or accreditation, promotion route.

language.description: Three-way split; never infer from the language of the web page.

admission_requirement.description: Language test/level required for admission, or 'not stated'.

source_url.description: Official page stating the language requirement (http/https URL) or null. Only real URLs go here; explanatory text goes in source_note. Must be a page the agent actually opened. Never invent a URL.

source_note.description: Free text about the source or why source_url is null (e.g. 'stated in the PDF study regulations, section 3').

household_fit.description: Fit for the applicant's household (dependants, partner, family funding). Optional: fill it whenever the life plan lists dependants or a partner (household.dependants > 0 or partner_moves = true).

dependants_allowed.description: May the applicant bring dependants (residence rules for students)? conditional = only above an income/housing threshold.

partner_work_rights.description: Does the partner get the right to work on a student's family permit?

family_allowance.description: Child/family allowance or dependant top-up with amount and period, or '' if none was found.

notes.description: Rules, thresholds and caveats (income proof for dependants, childcare, housing).

tuition.description: Tuition for the applicant's fee category.

amount_text.description: As published, with currency, year and cycle. Highest-error field in the reference run: always give the academic year.

applies_to.description: Fee category the amount applies to, in the institution's own words (e.g. 'international', 'home', 'all').

currency.description: ISO 4217 code if a single currency applies.

annual_amount.description: Numeric per-year amount in `currency`, if unambiguous.

confidence.description: Confidence in this figure for the intake the applicant would use.

amount.description: Amount with currency and period, as published.

applicant_eligible.description: Is the APPLICANT (given the facts in the life plan) eligible? confirmed = rule read and checked against the applicant's facts; inferred; unknown; n/a = not applicable.

eligibility_detail.description: The rule that drives the eligibility call (nationality, age, years since degree, residence...).

url.description: Official page for the scheme. Must be a page the agent actually opened, or null (then add a note and an open_question). Never invent a URL.

verdict.description: funded_confirmed = ~zero tuition AND confirmed stipend the applicant is eligible for; tuition_free_no_stipend; low_cost; competitive_scholarship_only; fails = funding CONFIRMED absent (never because evidence is missing); unknown.

overlays.description: Schemes kept OUT of the base funding score (e.g. home-country scholarships with return obligations). effect is the funding score IF the scheme is awarded.

effect.description: Funding score (0-3) the record would have if this scheme is awarded.

deadlines.description: Application and funding deadlines, structured so they can be sorted and checked.

date.description: The date. For date_type 'pattern' this is last cycle's date used as a proxy.

date_type.description: confirmed = published for the intake the applicant would use; pattern = same date as previous cycle, new one not yet published; inferred = derived from other information.

source_url.description: Page that states the date (null only for inferred).

intake.description: Intake months / rolling admission, free text.

benchmark_comparison.description: One sentence per benchmark axis: how this record compares to the run's three benchmarks.

confidence.description: Per-claim confidence. Recommended keys: curriculum, pathway, tuition, funding, deadlines, language. Use 'overall' if only one value is available.

confidence_note.description: Free-text explanation of the confidence levels.

open_questions.description: Things still unknown (mean 3.2 per record in the reference run).

contact_actions.description: Concrete questions to send to a named role before relying on the record.

who.description: Role to ask (e.g. 'programme coordinator', 'PI of group X').

source.description: Consortium page. Must be a page the agent actually opened, or null (then add a note and an open_question). Never invent a URL.
